description: S462 Q18 twin — `show=` hides, it does not remove: the button and its listener exist while `@user` is `not`, so a handler under `show=@user` does NOT keep the narrowing; the bare `@user.name` in it is E-TYPE-046.
rationale: §42.3.5 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a", Q18): only an `if=` / `else-if=` gate keeps a handler's narrowing; `show=` (hides, does not remove) stays as Q12 — the handler starts un-narrowed.
